verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents its own token-issuing capability: the MCP plugin makes the app an OAuth authorization server and protected resource, but only for MCP clients. The Device Authorization plugin implements the RFC 8628 code issuance flow, and the JWT plugin exposes token and JWKS endpoints. A community user says it can act as an identity provider and OIDC/SSO provider, but notes some such features are enterprise-only. missing for 10: first-party docs for a general-purpose OAuth/OIDC provider (third-party client registration, authorization-code flow, consent screen, 'Sign in with my app' for arbitrary clients), clarity on which provider features are enterprise-gated, hands-on corroboration.
